subject: prevent  computation and plotting inside a tab upon clicking into such tab for the first time

messages.author: b22f292cea7ef575
messages.subject: prevent  computation and plotting inside a tab upon clicking into such tab for the first time
parts:
I have a PlotTab that contains a plot that would involve heavy computation. I would not want the plot to be generated/refreshed/updated unless the actionButton is clicked.  I have achieved this goal, in most part, by using isolate().

However, I noticed that upon click into the PlotTab, even for the first time when the actionButton has never been clicked yet, this plot will be generated (after a while of computations).  Is there a way to prevent the initial plotting upon clicking into the PlotTab? 

Regards,
Xiaohua

messages.author: f1a78b77bed56547
messages.subject: Re: prevent  computation and plotting inside a tab upon clicking into such tab for the first time
parts:
I have done something like this, and I think this should work:

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
   block = reactiveValues()
   block$plot_tab == TRUE

   output$plot <- renderPlot({
      if (block$plot_tab) return(NULL)
      # plotting code here
      block$plot_tab = TRUE
   })

   observer({
      input$action_button
      #action button stuff here
      block$plot_tab = FALSE
   })

}

messages.subject: Re: prevent  computation and plotting inside a tab upon clicking into such tab for the first time
parts:
Your code does not work for me as-is, however, I was inspired by your example.

By simply adding an early return as follows in the code preceding the heavy calculation, I achieved my goal.  Thanks.

largedata <- reactive({
input$action_button
if(input$action_button == 0) return(NULL)

isolate({
<calculation code involving other user inputs>
})

})
